args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 deploy caused health check failures across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18%. Mitigation: Rolled back production to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The initial rollback orchestration halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error, leaving regions in a mixed state (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west/eu-west still on v2.3.1). A follow-up deploy of v2.3.0 to all regions completed successfully. Current status: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up needed: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failures and the orchestrator error during rollback.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.3.0
